verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an OpenAI-compatible base URL for chat completions and says to pick a model "from our catalog". Nothing documents a GET /v1/models-style endpoint, or any other programmatic way to list the live catalog. The generic "drop-in OpenAI replacement" claim covers inference and cannot be credited as a documented model-listing endpoint, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec that might expose one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
